title: POST /save body
description: A door's save request. `source` is never in the body: it comes from the bearer token, so a door cannot claim to be another door. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored (forward compatibility); a client that sends none of `link`/`note` is writing nothing and gets a 400. `note` is capped in characters here and in bytes by the 96 KB body cap enforced before parsing.
